My dog absolutely loves Urban Pooch, and I always have peace of mind when he’s there for daycare or boarding. The entire staff seems to know every single dog by name, and I’ve yet to encounter anyone that’s not super friendly and helpful. Highly recommend!

We have 2 dogs that go to daycare here, and we absolutely love the people who work with them! They’re always excited to see us and remember every dog’s name as they’re walking in. We even get a special song by one of the women! You can tell they care. We also have one dog that is very borderline on being openly social, and they’ve worked with us to help him not be fearful and teach him how to play nicely. I can’t recommend them enough. While it is pricey for us to send 2 dogs at a time, it’s very much worth it for us. We also did their Levels classes for initial training, and it helped us bond with our dogs while teaching them their basic training as well as other tricks and stunts on agility equipment.

Amanda does such a good job grooming my boys, I couldn’t be happier! One of my dogs is a Brussels Griffon which requires hand stripping, and she is exceptional at doing that. Both my boys look always look so good when they leave this place every five weeks. Highly recommend!

The staff here is also excellent! Always friendly and helpful. I’ve not had a negative experience in the years that we’ve been here. Would definitely recommend!

Every day our walk is not complete without a stop to see the team for pets and treats. Deb has been grooming them and keeping them adorable for over 7 years. I can't say enough wonderful things about Urban Pooch and, especially, Sharon Ciernak.
When I adopted my pit bull, she was timid, frightened, and unsure of the world. Today she's a confident, happy, well-mannered member of our community, and that transformation is thanks to Sharon.
What makes Sharon exceptional is that she didn't just train my dog—she taught me how to communicate with and train her. That changed everything. The bond we have today is unlike any relationship I've ever had with a dog. We trust each other completely, and every success we've had started with Sharon's guidance.
I will be eternally grateful for her patience, knowledge, and encouragement. If you're struggling with your dog, or simply want the best possible relationship with them, don't try to do it alone. Go to Sharon. She has the experience and the gift to help both you and your dog succeed.
Thank you, Sharon, for giving us a life together that I never imagined was possible.

My 15 lbs loves the daycare. They take great care of the dogs. My pup is always super excited to play at Urban Pooch.

We brought our dog (soft coated wheaten terrier, born May 2025) to get groomed here 3 times - 2x to get a less intense "clean up" where his face was lightly trimmed/he was washed/nails cut, and then once for his first full grooming on January 16. He was 8 months old at this point. We came to Urban Pooch given the praise-worthy reviews.

When I arrived, I spoke with the groomer, mentioned this is his first real grooming, we'll cut his puppy coat off etc. When I called to check in on Gunner during his grooming, I could hear his distressed barks in the background but figured it was being handled. Upon picking him up, the groomer did not come out nor say anything about the grooming. I was simply given my dog and bid adieu.

Upon getting home, our dog began shaking his head pretty frequently. This continued all weekend long, and per my internet searching, this was seemingly because his ears were shaved down/he no longer had as much hair on there as he was used to. By Monday morning, he developed scabs on the inside edges of his ears that were thick, almost like welts, and he had a double bacterial ear infection. The scabs were cuts on the leather of his ear, and every time he shook his head, the scabs would open back up, bleed more and thicken. Our vet confirmed that this appeared to be an injury from grooming. When we called Urban Pooch to ask if there were any incidents during the grooming, they simply said his ear infection was due to the fact that they removed hair from his ear canal.

Total treatment time to get his ears back to normal was about 6 weeks. In speaking to some dog friends in the neighborhood, we received a recommendation for a different compassionate groomer that does other wheatens. Today, our dog went there, and they called us to let us know that our dog has a trauma response to the blow dryer, often times caused by inexperienced groomers who push past a puppy's boundaries to "get the job done". Today's groomer let us know that she would try to give him some time to decompress but that the service may not be able to be completed to prevent further distress/unsafety for the dog. This is a logical, compassionate approach to a dog who may be a little spooked, and something that I as an owner highly appreciate.

The lack of communication of any issues during the grooming at Urban Pooch, the cuts on his ears, and now our pup's trauma that we will need to work through lead me to this 2 star review. Would have been 1 star but we liked the groomers who did the first two "clean ups" for our boy. Proceed with caution.

If we could give more than 5 stars, we absolutely would! Our dog, Denali, has been going to Urban Pooch for daycare 2–3 times a week since she was a puppy, and after 2½ years, we’ve truly never had a single negative experience.

The staff is incredible - so friendly, welcoming, and you can tell they genuinely love what they do and every dog they work with. They treat Denali like she’s their own, and that means everything to us. We always feel completely at ease knowing she’s in such great hands whenever she’s there.

We’ve also used their boarding several times, and it’s been just as amazing. One of our favorite things is that Denali gets to play all day in daycare and then sleeps in a room with other dogs and a staff member at night. She’s never stuck in a crate for long periods, which is such a huge plus and something we really value.

We truly can’t say enough good things about Urban Pooch. It’s clear how much the staff cares, and there’s honestly nowhere else we’d rather have Denali when we’re at work or out of town. Highly, highly recommend for both daycare and boarding!
I came here for a job interview and during my shadow I got to see the facility, it's one of the best in the city. I would highly recommend it. The dogs are very well taken care of.

I ordered a few harness in their online store on Jan 19 2026 as their online store shows they have colours I like. These colours are discontinued in my area. As they only deliver local so I asked a friend of mine who lives in Chicago to receive the order via her address and she agreed to do me a favor. Plus I checked on their website that address is within local delivery distance. I placed the order on Jan 19 and waited 2 days no shipping confirmation or email to inform when items will be delivered (website shows process time is 24 hours). So I called the store. The staff on the phone didn’t know exact how many products in stock. She first told me items will be on back order then told me she will check stock. After like 15mins, they finally found out that only 1 of each colour I ordered in stock (which means their online store shows wrong information.) and then she said my friend’s address is not within their deliver distance (which again website shows wrong information plus I successfully placed order via local delivery method already). So I was like okay maybe I can buy other sizes as only 2 of the sizes I ordered in stock as I am buying these harness as gifts for friends. During staff went to check stock  the third time,  a store manager took over the phone told me they want to make sure I ordered the right size, I told them I was buying for friends so I can switch to other sizes, she insisted that I got the wrong sizes. I told her I have 2 dogs myself, and buying discontinued colours for my friends, and I was 100% sure that I am buying the correct size and wouldn’t return. Then she told me they can’t sell products to me as I am suspicious?????? I placed an order 2 days ago and paid online and no update on stock or anything until I called them and now I am suspicious? Your online store shows completely wrong info about stocking and delivery area and it’s my fault?
The staff here are so lovely and you can tell they all just adore dogs. Our pup is a little shy around other dogs but enjoys getting pets and treats when we stop in or when she attends day care.
Thank you!
Our Tails are Wagging! Thx for Your Review!

After lunch next door I heard
a chorus of bright barks,
so I wandered in to see the place
that sparked such happy sparks.

The staff lit up to greet me,
and with genuine delight
they showed me every corner
of their daycare done just right.

They walked me through the process,
every detail, every check:
a flu shot for my puppies,
a fecal test to vet their health.
Then gentle, careful integration
helped my pups feel safe and sound
two hours first, then half-day visits,
building trust with solid ground.

I loved the rooms for roaming,
for snoozing, play, or pace,
with humans in the playroom
keeping watch on every face.

The grooming is a bonus,
and the “daycare plus a trim”
means drop-off days are easy
and our schedule’s never grim.

My backyard’s been a casualty
of puppies, youth, and mud,
so this bright space is heaven
for the furry little flood.

The rates are fair, the hours kind,
the atmosphere feels true.
Urban Pooch has won my heart,
and my puppies love it too.

A place of trust and wagging tails,
of joy and social play,
I am grateful for this find
and we’ll be back many a day.

Our dog is a bit on the anxious side in new environments. It took him about a month to not seem anxious going in. He has been attending day care at Urban Pooch for approximately 7 months attending twice a week just for socialization. He absolutely loves it. He now knows the drive there and gets so excited the closer we get to day care. He gets happy to see his day care people when he goes in and does not even look back at me going in anymore. He goes in without hesitation and genuinely seems happier at home. The people are great here and true animal lovers. I highly recommend Urban Pooch!

I’ve been taking my dog to Urban Pooch for 5 years now.  He’s safe, loved and goes in and comes out very happy! The staff are so nice and welcoming.  Dogs are not crated annd they roam freely and someone is in the room with them 24/7.  It’s a darling place for my precious dog.  And groomer Deb is awesome.  Tiffany and everyone there is amazing!
Thank you!

We’ve been using Urban Pooch for daycare and boarding for about seven years. We first started going with our older boxer when we moved to the neighborhood, and after she passed, our new boxer has been going since the day she was old enough. She loves it. When I grab her leash in the morning, she knows she’s going to daycare and completely loses her mind with excitement. I can barely get the leash on before she’s pulling me out the door and straight to the building.

The staff is always kind and clearly loves the dogs they care for. I have zero complaints and appreciate having a place I trust completely with our girl.

First off I will begin saying I am not one to give reviews, but my wife and I are extremely disappointed. I could give this place 0 stars if it was an option.

My experience with Urban Pooch has been nothing short of awful. Every time my wife or I walked into the facility, the smell inside was overwhelming and honestly made me question how often the place is properly cleaned and sanitized. It was quite disgusting and immediately made me worry and second guess about the environment my dog was being kept in.

On top of that, the staff we have dealt with were consistently unfriendly, dismissive, and at times downright rude. Any time I tried to ask basic questions or raise concerns, I felt brushed off like I was an inconvenience and should have showed no concern about my dog.

Even worse, we have repeatedly witnessed dogs getting into fights while staff stood around or reacted far too slowly. It also seemed that there was noticeable inner mingling with employees that made it clear relationships in the work place should not be allowed, as this seems why some of the focus for the dogs was not there.

From what we saw, there was little effort to separate dogs or keep things under control, and because of this, my dog has developed severe anxiety and consistently hides and cowers. Maybe if employees were not allowed to be on their phones during working hours without it being emergent, more attention and effort could have been made. I do have to say that I absolutely regret ever trusting this place with my pet.

Overall, our personal experience with Urban Pooch has been terrible, and I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone who actually cares about their dog’s well-being, let alone being respected. And quite overpriced I would say for someone who is looking for affordable options.

But, what we can say is that Kayla, Tuck or Tucker and a girl with we believe blue hair, deserve better appreciation. Sadly, if we could of potentially had more interactions with them, then maybe more stars wpuld be given for how respectful and caring these individuals presented.
Thank you!

Our pup Shay just finished the 4-week Puppy Paw Star Academy at Urban Pooch, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. The difference in her is incredible — she’s more confident, listens better, plays nicely with other dogs, and just seems more calm and grounded overall. It honestly feels like we’re living with a whole new dog (in the best way).

One of the things we really appreciated was how involved we got to be throughout the process. Every day, the trainers sent photos, videos, and a quick write-up on what Shay worked on and how she did. It gave us a clear picture of her progress and made it so much easier to reinforce the training at home. And any time we had questions or concerns — even small stuff — the team was super responsive, patient, and happy to talk things through.

What really sets Urban Pooch apart is the people. Every single staff member we met was kind, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about what they do. They took the time to get to know Shay and made her feel completely comfortable and cared for. She ran through the door every morning, tail wagging, and we never had a moment of hesitation leaving her there.

Urban Pooch truly became a second home for her — and honestly, we’re going to miss the daily drop-offs. If you have a new puppy and you’re even thinking about training, don’t wait. This is absolutely the place to go. We’re so glad we did.
Thank you!

Hi Fabiola,Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We noticed that your review mentions Urban Pooch but also indicates it’s been six years since your visit was at our Training and Fitness Center. We are truly committed to providing excellent service, and a one-star rating is certainly not something we take lightly. Given the length of time that has passed, we're curious to understand what prompted your review at this time and if there is anything specific we can address.We would greatly appreciate the opportunity to learn more about your experience. Please feel free to contact our Director of Operations, Dylan Feulner, at dylan@urbanpooch.com. He would be happy to discuss your visit and gather more details to help us improve.
Thank you!
